name: Browser Page
description: Open a URL in a session and wait for it to be ready. Returns the final URL, title, HTML, and visible text.
doc:
Drive a Browser Session to a URL.

Wait strategies:
• Page Load (default) - waits for the load event
• DOM Ready - earlier, fires on parse
• Network Idle - waits for network to go quiet (heavier)

If you also fill in 'Wait For Selector', the node blocks until that selector exists in the DOM after the wait condition.

Returns { url, title, html, text } so you can chain Browser Extract or pipe directly into other nodes.

properties.name: URL
properties.description: URL to open (used if no URL input is connected)

properties.name: Wait For Selector
properties.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for after the wait condition

properties.name: Settle (ms)
properties.description: Extra delay after wait (lets dynamic content render)
